import os
p='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689764/attempts/e81e54f2f2424f1b8a6d71322cea1218/system/state/workspace/programs/task-b9a29792.py'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Replace the 8-marked rectangle with values mirrored across the main diagonal.
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 8]
    if not cells:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid[r0:r1 + 1]]
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            out[r-r0][c-c0] = grid[c][r]
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
